tasks.stem: Thanks for taking part. Let's begin by talking about your lifestyle. Are there any types of movement or physical effort you enjoy more than others—like walking, dancing, doing chores, or something else?
I see. When people try to build more physical movement into their lives, what do you think helps them succeed or makes it difficult?
Interesting. What kind of effect do you think social media and online influencers have on the way people think about health and fitness issues these days?
Good points. One last question. In your view, how important is it for workplaces or schools to provide breaks or spaces for physical activity during the day?
